dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Acute angular steepness approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.5:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum.
